movie.title: House on Haunted Hill
movie.overview: When a group of friends is drawn to a remote island by a cryptic invitation, they uncover a centuries-old curse that turns their getaway into a fight for survival.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A mysterious invitation draws a group of friends to an isolated island, where they must confront a ancient curse to survive the night.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A group of friends accepts a cryptic invitation to a remote island, expecting an exclusive getaway. However, their retreat quickly turns treacherous as they inadvertently unleash a centuries-old curse haunting the property. Cut off from the mainland, they are forced to band together to survive the night. As fear and paranoia mount, they must unravel the island's dark history before it consumes them all.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seeking an unforgettable escape, a tight-knit group of friends responds to a cryptic invitation granting them access to an enigmatic, secluded island. Upon arrival, the idyllic atmosphere rapidly fades as strange, unexplainable phenomena begin to torment the guests. They soon discover that the island harbors a dark past, bound by a terrifying curse that has slumbered for hundreds of years. Distrust grows within the group as the supernatural forces manipulate their deepest fears and secrets. With escape routes severed and no contact with the outside world, their luxurious retreat descends into a desperate nightmare. As the malevolent presence grows stronger, the survivors are forced to navigate hidden corridors and decipher ancient clues left behind by the island's previous occupants. Each revelation brings them closer to the truth, but at a devastating cost to their unity and sanity. In a tense climax against the clock, the remaining friends must make harrowing sacrifices to break the curse before dawn. Ultimately, they face a grim battle for survival where not everyone is destined to leave the island alive.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When an intriguing and mysterious invitation arrives, a group of close friends embarks on a journey to a remote island for an exclusive getaway. What begins as a memorable retreat soon devolves into a nerve-wracking ordeal as strange occurrences disrupt their stay. The island, steeped in forgotten history, holds a dark centuries-old curse that awakens to prey upon the unexpected visitors. Cut off from all help and facing rising tensions within their ranks, the group must decipher the mysteries of the island's past to survive the sinister forces working against them.

story_structure.climax: The dark history of the curse reaches its peak as the surviving friends face a ultimate confrontation against the island's full sinister forces.
story_structure.conflict: The guests discover that the property is tied to a centuries-old curse, trapping them on the island and forcing them to confront supernatural threats.
story_structure.resolution: The ordeal draws to a close, leaving the surviving group to pick up the pieces in the aftermath of their harrowing nightmare.
story_structure.introduction: A group of friends receives a cryptic invitation and arrives at a secluded house on a remote island, setting the scene for a seemingly intriguing getaway.
story_structure.risingAction: As strange and malevolent phenomena escalate, tension grows among the group, turning their struggle for answers into a desperate battle to stay alive.
